name: kraken-mod-manager
description: A lightweight, cross-platform mod manager for Kerbal Space Program.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @kraken/contracts build && pnpm --filter @kraken/core build && pnpm --parallel --filter @kraken/backend --filter @kraken/frontend dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kraken/contracts build && pnpm --filter @kraken/core build && pnpm --filter @kraken/frontend build && pnpm --filter @kraken/backend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kraken/contracts build && pnpm --filter @kraken/core build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @kraken/contracts build && pnpm --filter @kraken/core build && pnpm -r test
